basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm a 27-year-old digital marketing specialist from Portland, Oregon. In my free time, I love diving into tabletop RPGs and exploring the creative side of character development. My girlfriend and I often spend weekends engaged in fantasy campaigns. I'm also a car enthusiast with a soft spot for Volkswagen Tiguans, and I enjoy tweaking my home audio setup with subwoofers. Typically, I'm online in the evenings after work and on weekends. Currently in a happy relationship, I enjoy sharing hobbies with my partner.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Marketing and have spent the last five years working in digital marketing, focusing on social media strategies and content creation. My expertise in RPGs is mostly self-taught, developed through years of playing and DMing various campaigns. Additionally, my interest in automotive and audio technology is fueled by personal passion and online forums.
